taxonomy.note: Accepted species; accepted varieties var. altissima and var. angustata are preserved while the learner remains species-level.

evidence: Kew/POWO accepts Ageratina altissima and lists Texas within its native range.
USDA PLANTS-derived county data on rootfast marks A. altissima native in Bandera, Comal, Kerr, Medina and Travis Counties within the current project target zone.
The project Hays County native-source list independently includes A. altissima, but Hays is not required for the strict PASS because at least five other target counties are explicitly marked native.
target_zone_range.guardrail: Kew recognizes var. altissima and var. angustata. B016 remains species-level; do not assign a variety from leaf width alone without stronger material.

morphology.look_here_first: Look for opposite long-petioled broad leaves with coarse teeth and three strong basal veins, topped by loose white flat-topped clusters of tiny all-disk heads—no ray florets.
diagnostic_traits: erect rhizomatous perennial herb, often in shaded woods, canyon bottoms and moist edges
leaves opposite, simple, usually long-petioled below
blades broadly ovate to triangular, coarsely toothed, often with three strong veins from near the base
upper leaves may become smaller and shorter-petioled
inflorescence terminal and corymbiform/flat-topped with many small white heads
heads discoid: only white disk florets, no ray florets
involucral phyllaries narrow and pointed, arranged in several series
fruit a cypsela with a conspicuous white pappus

confusers.separator: Both have opposite leaves and flat-topped all-disk clusters. Ageratina has white heads and broader coarse-toothed leaves; Conoclinium has blue-violet heads and smaller triangular leaves.
A. havanensis is typically a woody/subshrubby shrub with smaller leaves; A. altissima is an herbaceous perennial with larger long-petioled leaves.
Late boneset has different, generally narrower leaf architecture and different phyllary characters; use leaf arrangement and involucre rather than white head color alone.

installation_guardrail: Do not install until Calvin explicitly approves B016 pass taxa.
